name: AnyAPI
tagline: One key for hundreds of scraping and data APIs, paid in USD.
description:
AnyAPI is a unified marketplace for scraping and data APIs: any API, one wallet, USD, no subscriptions. Reach hundreds of third-party APIs (social media, search results, web data) through one key and one normalized interface; pay per request in real dollars; failed calls are never charged because AnyAPI fails over across providers automatically under one price.

Tools: `list_apis`, `search_apis`, `get_api`, `quote_api`, `run_api`, `read_result`, `get_balance`. Every API exposes a normalized input/output JSON Schema, so the agent discovers, inspects, quotes, and runs any of them with the same loop.

env.name: ANYAPI_API_KEY
env.description: AnyAPI key (aa_live_...). Create one at getanyapi.com/dashboard/keys.

install.notes: Discovery tools are free to call. `run_api` charges the wallet in USD on success only.
